goal: 28 billion completed scalar walk updates per second on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
algorithmicBoundary: Generic-group square-root scaling: Omega(sqrt(n / 262)) with the same automorphism quotient; unchanged by kernel tuning.
scope: Pollard walk kernel and DP collection. This is not an index-calculus solver or a full-DLP speedup claim; the WDSat solver regression is inapplicable.

geometryScreen.caveat: Grid sizes use different seed panels; this ranks configurations but does not establish a matched-corpus gain. First rows are retained without claiming thermal steady state.

promotion: Fresh paired confirmation after screening, at least five pairs, a 95% paired confidence interval excluding no improvement, all correctness gates and equal verified workloads. To meet the 28B goal require >=28B/s unprofiled benchmark median on the target GPU and no DP34 regression.
otherHardware: Record G7 RTX PRO 4500 separately; do not scale its rate into a claimed RTX PRO 6000 measurement.
cloudLimit: One active benchmark GPU, 45-minute workload timeout, 50-minute controller deadline, independent 55-minute shutdown.
